articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Buffett's 'trips down YouTube rabbit hole' revealed
articles.description: Warren Buffett watches CNBC in the morning, but nearly every evening he "can't get enough" of watching YouTube clips while sitting on a recliner in front of an "enormous" television in his Omaha home, reports The Wall Street Journal.

articles.title: From BJ’s to Lululemon, retailers are trimming assortments to boost business
articles.description: Retail brands are shrinking assortments to get back to healthy growth, while box stores are culling products to better curate offerings and stabilize business.

articles.title: Hollywood takes on Zuckerberg, Musk and Altman amid widespread anxiety over AI
articles.description: New films about Zuckerberg, Musk, Altman and AI arrive as public concern about the technology and its leaders rises.

articles.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.description: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
articles.description: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

articles.title: Nvidia GPUs are everywhere. Here are the ways companies are accessing them
articles.description: One industry researcher identified over 300 neoclouds that can provide GPU capacity, up about 55% in less than a year.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.description: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
articles.description: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

articles.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
articles.description: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile’s Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.

articles.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
articles.description: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

articles.title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant
articles.description: Cash-strapped farmers have no incentive to sow for 2027 with exports remaining trapped, as analysts say commodity markets could "flip fast."

articles.title: AI is changing how lawyers work — and putting the billable hour under pressure
articles.description: AI adoption is forcing the legal profession to rethink the billable hour and how lawyers build expertise.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
articles.description: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

articles.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
articles.description: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

articles.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
articles.description: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

articles.title: Trump's diesel agreement with Putin accused of contradicting Russia sanctions law
articles.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a searing statement that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."

articles.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Earnings kick off as banks and chipmakers face big tests
articles.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said next week’s earnings reports will give investors a clearer picture of corporate performance and the strength of the AI trade.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
articles.description: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.
